OIL INDIA LIMITED - DULIAJAN
DAILY DRILLING REPORT
WELL: DUL-011          FIELD: Duliajan          RIG: OIL-RIG-14
REPORT DATE: 11-Mar-2019          REPORT NO: 042

11-Mar-2019: 0600-1400 hrs: Drilling 12-1/4" hole ahead from 2402m to 2461m in
GIRUJAN CLAY, ROP avg 8.2 m/hr, MW 1.32 sg, no losses. 1400 hrs: Circulated
bottoms up prior to POOH for bit change, samples normal.

1430 hrs: While POOH for bit change, string got stuck at 2460m MD in Girujan
clay, unable to work string free by rotating or reciprocating. Overpull 40
klbf above normal. Worked string, no free. Rigged up to spot pill.

1600 hrs: Mixed and spotted 15 bbl pipe-freeing pill across stuck interval.
Soaked 2 hrs. 1800 hrs: Worked string free with 35 klbf overpull, string came
free at 2460m. Resumed POOH, no further tightness.

2000-2400 hrs: Changed bit (worn, graded 4-4-WT), RIH to bottom, no problems.
NPT this 24 hrs: 3.5 hrs (stuck pipe while tripping).
